properties.name: Phase 6, PR 1: the argument skill, objections aimed at a step, and every line's assumptions
properties.rationale:
Anthony's "Start phase 6" (2026-10-20); the split proposed puts the argument skill, step objections and per-line assumptions first, as the epoch says. Choices made where the requirements left one, each recorded as a proposed idea for the owner: (1) a step an established, unanswered objection defeats reads `fails` (dec:idea-a-step-an-established-objection-defeats-reads-fails-or-unknown); (2) the skill records a principle in `assumed` on each step that applies it, so positions read conditional on their principles (dec:idea-a-principle-in-an-argument-is-assumed-or-taken-as-given). Also: (3) a contested claim still names the lines it holds on before the objection is counted; (4) a step that does not hold keeps reading the union of what its premises rest on, so non-holding readings are unchanged; (5) at most 32 lines per reading, lightest first, and a k_of_n step over more than 256 combinations takes all holding premises together, each saying it was capped; (6) the reasoning_report tool description was left unchanged, because extending it made acknowledge_gap and gap_to_prompt a new confusable pair in find_tools; (7) brainstorm's description said "a line of reasoning" and outranked the new skill for that query, so it now says "the thread of thought". Failing first on main 50af571: 7 of 8 core tests failed (the 8th pins the existing mutual-objection recipe) and all 3 MCP tests failed. Fixtures: the trolley (4c35490abf0cefdf) and cogito (989598dd02246a81) designs exported read-only from flo2.io at 0.89.0.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three requirements of epoch:planned-p6-argument-gaps, no schema stamp move (no type, property or edge added; one schema description extended), no tool added or changed (200 tools, toolsnaps unchanged). The served design-an-argument skill and /design-an-argument command; design-a-proof points to it; find_skills ranks it first for "argument", "line of reasoning", "for and against". An opposing CONTRADICTS into an Inference is read against the step: holds → defeated (fails; conclusion unsupported, never refuted), stands → contested, answered → reinstated (`objections`, `objected` on inference_reading; `steps_objected` on reasoning_report, which walks step objectors from the claim). Every reading keeps every minimal line with what it holds under; a step crosses its premises' lines by its rule, so it inherits only its cheapest line; a claim names every line in `holds_under_any_of` (read-back, foundations, proof status); an objection's scope is what every line of its target holds under.
